_comment: Style for the burned-in debug notes -- the running commentary that says what the cut did at each moment and why. Deliberately plain and unbranded: this is an instrument, not a graphic, and it should never be mistaken for part of the film.
_why: Sizes are in PlayRes units, and PlayRes is set to the video's own pixel size by debug-notes.py, so these numbers are pixels at 1280x720 and scale with the frame.
_accent: The first line of each note is the heading, drawn in this instead.
_corner: bottom-left, bottom-centre, bottom-right, top-left, top-centre, top-right
